anomalies.observed: The VDD power pins of both the FCC (STM32H753) and NAVC (STM32F405) MCUs are on unconnected nets, not tied to any 3.3V rail.
anomalies.expected: All VDD pins should be connected to the 3.3V rail, as the specification states that 3V3 feeds both MCUs.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: The MCUs receive no power and the board cannot function.

anomalies.observed: The LDO output (REG2.1) is on net +3.3V, while the MCU VBAT, pull-up resistors, and buffer VCC are on a separate net +3V3. There is no connection between +3.3V and +3V3.
anomalies.expected: The LDO output and the MCU/sensor supply should be the same 3.3V rail, as the specification states the LDO produces 3V3 for MCUs and sensors.

evidence.quote: An LD39200PU33R LDO, fed from the 5 V rail, produces 3V3 for "MCUs and Sensors"

anomalies.impact: The +3V3 rail has no power source, so the MCUs, pull-ups, and buffer on that rail are unpowered even if their VDD pins were connected.

anomalies.observed: The PS (protocol select) pin of the BMI088 IMU is tied to +3.3V (logic high).
anomalies.expected: For I2C operation, the PS pin must be tied low (GND). The specification states the BMI088 uses I2C addresses 0x19 and 0x69.

evidence.quote: IMU (accel + gyro) | NAVCPeripherals | Bosch BMI088, I2C addr 0x19 (acc) / 0x69 (gyr)

anomalies.impact: The BMI088 is placed in SPI mode instead of I2C mode, so I2C communication with the IMU will fail and no inertial data will be available.

These issues would prevent the board from powering up or functioning as intended.
